name: Domino Cocoa Patisserie
description: A light cocoa-and-pistachio pâtisserie for a single bakery: a top bar with the shop’s hours and contact, a cocoa header with the shop’s name drawn as a centred italic wordmark, a hero of collection names over photos, counters on a scalloped cocoa band, the four best-selling collections as cards, how ordering works, three ways to receive an order, a gallery of the collections, today’s selection as rows, a photo band, a marquee of the collections and the journal; a bag drawer and a footer with a Theme row; dark through the footer.
